statement: The pinned Linux Nintendo Switch 2 consumer creates one right-half input device with ABS_X and ABS_Y spanning -32768 to 32767, A/B/X/Y, R and ZR, plus, stick click, Home, C, SL/SR and grip-side input. It conditionally offers FF_RUMBLE. No mouse or motion evdev axis is registered in that initialization path.

applicability.scope: Linux right USB consumer evdev buttons, axes and conditional output
